title: JUDGE – MATCH 2N2 NS (16–18/04/2026)
summary: Repeating the significant journey of 42 former KP27 – Rutgers Long Ping, Nai Province on its return to the source in the Holy Land of the Island.

content.text: Repeating the significant journey of 42 former KP27 – Rutgers Long Ping, Nai Province on its return to the source in the Holy Land of the Island.
The journey was not just a tour but also an opportunity for the uncles to review the proud memories, to understand the past, and to look for the spiritual values of the people.
The crew have come to offer incense at Miss Fei-er, visiting Guan Shan Temple – where the prayers of peace are sent.
Relaxing at the Silk Beach with wild, peaceful beauty.
In particular, in the solemn atmosphere, the crew made a respectful visit to the Pacific Cemetery, lighting incense at the hero's part of the 6th Mayor's hero's grave – the faithful red land.
Visiting the Coon Island Prison System, which retains the tragic historical markings of the nation.
In the evening, the warm Gala Dinner program brought happy, attached moments, spread the spirit of teammates and fellowism.
The trip was closed but the values of gratitude, patriotism, and bond would remain in each member of the Chi.
TODAYOURIST Thank you for the KP27 Veterans' Trust in Choices and Associates. May the uncles remain healthy, happy, and continue as a model for the younger generation to follow.
